name: Jira for Teams and Administrators
certifications: ACP-420 Managing Jira Service Projects for Cloud
ACP-620 Managing Jira Projects for Cloud

beginner.summary: For team members, Scrum Masters, product owners and new space admins who are starting with Jira Cloud. Covers spaces and work items (formerly projects and issues), a lab site, work types, fields and hierarchy, Scrum and Kanban boards, JQL, filters and dashboards, workflows, automation, agile reports, timelines and Plans, releases, development tool connections, Jira Service Management, business spaces, Jira Product Discovery, Rovo AI features, space permissions and common problems.
prerequisites: Works in a team that plans and tracks work
outcomes: Plan and track work with Scrum and Kanban boards, work items and releases
Find and report on work with JQL, filters, dashboards and agile reports
Configure simple workflows, automation and space permissions
Use Jira Service Management, Product Discovery and Rovo features for everyday work

days.topic: Jira Overview: Spaces, Work Items and the Atlassian Cloud
subtopics: Jira, Jira Service Management and Jira Product Discovery
The Atlassian cloud platform and Rovo
Cloud plans: Free, Standard, Premium and Enterprise
Data Center end of life and moving to cloud
Course project overview: a product team and a service desk
days.lab_task: Tour the course Jira site, open a Scrum space, a Kanban space and a service space, and map which Jira apps and space types the course company needs.
checks: One space of each type is opened
Needed apps and space types are listed with reasons
Spaces and work items are explained with their old names

days.topic: Lab Setup: Jira Cloud Site, Users and a First Space
subtopics: Creating a free or trial cloud site
Creating a team-managed space from a template
Checking the lab site is ready
days.lab_task: Create a cloud site, invite five users into groups, create one team-managed and one company-managed space, set leads and connect Confluence.
days.deliverable: Ready lab site with users and two spaces
checks: Users can sign in with the right product access
Confluence pages link to Jira work

days.topic: Work Items: Work Types, Fields, Hierarchy and Linking
subtopics: Work types such as epic, story, task, bug and subtask
The work hierarchy and parent links
days.lab_task: Create an epic with stories, tasks and subtasks, link a blocking bug, add labels and components and bulk-change ten work items.
checks: Epics, stories and subtasks follow the hierarchy
The blocking link shows on both items
Ten items are changed in one operation

days.topic: Scrum Boards: Backlog, Sprints and Estimation
subtopics: Completing sprints and carrying work over
days.lab_task: Refine a backlog with estimates, plan and start a sprint with a goal, run it on the board with quick filters and close it with carried-over work.
checks: The sprint has a goal and estimated work
Unfinished work moves to the next sprint

days.topic: Kanban Boards: Columns, WIP Limits and Flow
days.lab_task: Configure a Kanban board with WIP limits, swimlanes for expedite work and card colours, run a week of seeded work and find the bottleneck.
days.deliverable: Configured Kanban board and flow notes
checks: Work moves through the board for a week

days.topic: Searching with JQL: Fields, Operators and Functions
subtopics: Functions such as currentUser and openSprints
Searching history with WAS and CHANGED
days.lab_task: Write JQL for your open work, bugs created last week, items that changed status yesterday and work in open sprints, and save them as filters.
checks: Each query returns the expected items
WAS and CHANGED queries find past states
Filters are saved and shared with the team

days.topic: Filters, Dashboards and Gadgets
subtopics: Gadgets: filter results, pie charts and created versus resolved
days.lab_task: Build a team dashboard from saved filters with four gadgets, subscribe the team to a weekly filter email and share the dashboard with the stakeholders group.
checks: The dashboard shows four useful gadgets
Stakeholders can view but not edit

days.topic: Workflows: Statuses, Transitions and the Workflow Editor
days.lab_task: Add a review status and transitions to the team workflow, require a field on one transition, map the board columns and test the flow.
checks: The new status and transitions work
The transition asks for the required field
objectives: Keep boards in step with workflows

days.topic: Jira Automation: Triggers, Conditions and Actions
subtopics: Actions: edit, transition, comment and notify
days.lab_task: Build rules that assign new bugs to the triage lead, close parent stories when subtasks are done and post a weekly summary, then read the audit logs.
checks: Parents close when subtasks are done

days.topic: Agile Reports: Burndown, Velocity, Cumulative Flow and Control Chart
days.lab_task: Read the sprint burndown, velocity and control chart for three seeded sprints, explain what went wrong in one sprint and present two improvements.
checks: The problem sprint's cause is supported by data
Two improvements are proposed with measures

days.topic: Timelines, Plans and Dependencies
days.lab_task: Plan two epics on the timeline with dependencies, build a plan across two teams with capacity and compare two release scenarios.
checks: Two scenarios are compared with a decision

days.topic: Releases, Versions and Components
days.lab_task: Create two versions, assign work, generate release notes, release one version with unfinished work moved and set component leads.
checks: The version is released with notes
Components assign work to their leads

days.topic: Connecting Development Tools: Bitbucket, GitHub, GitLab and Confluence
subtopics: Linking commits, branches and pull requests
days.lab_task: Connect a code repository, link commits and a pull request to work items, move work with an automation rule on merge and link a requirements page in Confluence.
checks: Commits and pull requests show on work items
The requirements page links to the epic

days.topic: Jira Service Management: Requests, Queues and SLAs
days.lab_task: Create a service space with three request types, queues and two SLAs, raise requests from the portal as customers and resolve them as agents.
checks: Customers raise requests through the portal

days.topic: Business Spaces for Non-Software Teams
subtopics: Templates for HR, marketing and finance
When to use Jira or another tool
days.lab_task: Build a marketing campaign space with a form for requests, a calendar view and an approval step, and run three requests through it.

days.topic: Jira Product Discovery: Ideas, Insights and Prioritisation
subtopics: Views: list, board, matrix and timeline
days.lab_task: Collect ten ideas with insights, score them, build a prioritisation matrix and a roadmap view, and link the top idea to delivery work.
checks: The top idea links to delivery work

days.topic: Rovo and AI in Jira: Summaries, Work Breakdown and Agents
subtopics: Breaking down epics into work items
days.lab_task: Summarise a long work item, break an epic into stories with AI and edit them, turn three questions into JQL and use a Rovo agent for a routine task.
checks: The summary matches the work item
Generated stories are reviewed and corrected

days.topic: Space Permissions and Roles for Space Admins
subtopics: Restricting work items with security levels
Granting access to people outside the team
days.lab_task: Set roles for a space, restrict security bugs to the security group, change notifications for one event and review who can see what.
checks: Users have the intended space roles
Only the security group sees security bugs
The changed notification goes to the right people

days.topic: Troubleshooting Common Jira Problems: Missing Work, Board Filters and Automation Failures
subtopics: Searching for root causes with JQL
Getting help from site admins and Atlassian Support
days.lab_task: Diagnose four seeded problems, missing work on a board, a failing automation rule, a permission error and wrong notifications, fix them and record the steps.
checks: A check or rule prevents each repeat

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Running a Team's Work in Jira for Two Sprints
days.lab_task: Run two sprints for the course product team with a refined backlog, workflow and automation, a service desk feeding bugs, a release and a dashboard for stakeholders.
days.deliverable: Two sprints of tracked work with a review
checks: Service requests become bugs in the backlog
Stakeholders read progress on the dashboard

intermediate.summary: For Jira site administrators and senior space admins, aligned with ACP-120 Jira Administration for Cloud. Covers cloud administration, schemes, custom fields and screens, complex workflows, automation at scale, advanced JQL and reporting apps, Jira Plans, scaled agile with Jira Align, Jira Service Management administration, incident and change management, REST APIs, webhooks and Forge apps, Atlassian Guard, data residency and sandboxes, migration from Data Center to cloud, Atlassian Analytics, Marketplace governance, Rovo agents, site governance and exam preparation.
prerequisites: Has managed spaces, boards and workflows in Jira
Supports several teams in one Jira site
outcomes: Administer Jira Cloud sites with schemes, fields, workflows and automation at scale
Run Jira Service Management with request types, SLAs, Assets, incidents and changes
Secure, integrate, migrate and govern Jira with Guard, APIs, Forge and Marketplace controls

days.topic: Jira Cloud Administration: Organisations, Sites and Product Access
subtopics: Admin roles: organisation, site and product admins
days.lab_task: Verify a domain, set default product access, build group-based access for three departments, deactivate a leaver and review the audit log.
checks: The domain is verified and accounts are managed
Departments get product access through groups

days.topic: Schemes: Permission, Notification, Work Type and Field Configuration Schemes
subtopics: Work type schemes and work type screen schemes
days.lab_task: Build a shared configuration for three spaces with permission, notification, work type, field configuration and workflow schemes, and change one safely.
checks: Three spaces use the shared schemes
A scheme change applies without breaking work items

days.topic: Custom Fields and Screens: Contexts, Field Configurations and Performance
subtopics: Field configurations: required and hidden fields
days.lab_task: Add three custom fields with contexts, place them on the right screens, make one required for bugs and remove two unused fields safely.
days.deliverable: Field configuration with a clean-up record
checks: Fields appear on the right screens
The field is required only for bugs
Unused fields are removed without data loss

days.topic: Complex Workflows: Conditions, Validators, Post Functions and Approvals
days.lab_task: Design a change workflow with an approval, a validator that requires a test plan, a condition by group and post functions, and test it in a copy space.
checks: The approval step works for approvers only
Transitions without a test plan are blocked
All paths pass in the copy space
objectives: Use conditions, validators and post functions

days.topic: Automation at Scale: Global Rules, Smart Values and Usage Limits
days.lab_task: Build a global rule that escalates stale critical work across spaces, a rule that calls a web service and a usage report that finds the heaviest rules.
days.deliverable: Global rules with a usage review
checks: Stale critical work is escalated in every space
The web request returns data used by the rule
The heaviest rules are found and optimised

days.topic: Advanced JQL and Reporting Apps
days.lab_task: Write JQL for cross-space hierarchy and link questions, build a time-in-status report and fix a slow dashboard filter.
checks: Time in status is reported per work type
The dashboard loads faster after the fix

days.topic: Jira Plans: Cross-Team Planning, Capacity and Scenarios
subtopics: Keeping plans in step with work
days.lab_task: Build a plan for three teams with an initiative level, capacity, cross-team dependencies and two scenarios, and share it with leadership.
checks: Initiatives, epics and stories roll up
Dependency and capacity warnings are resolved

days.topic: Scaling Agile in Jira: SAFe, Program Boards and Jira Align
days.lab_task: Run a simulated program increment planning for three teams with a program board, objectives and dependencies, and decide whether Jira Plans or Jira Align fits.
days.deliverable: Program increment plan and tool decision
checks: Teams commit objectives for the increment
Dependencies show on the program board

days.topic: Jira Service Management Administration: Request Types, Portals, SLAs and Assets
subtopics: Portal groups and help centre design
days.lab_task: Design request types with forms, SLA calendars for two regions, an Assets schema for laptops and link laptop objects to hardware requests.

days.topic: Incident and Change Management in Jira Service Management
days.lab_task: Run a major incident from an alert with on-call, write the post-incident review, and push a risky change through approval and a deployment gate.
days.deliverable: Incident record, review and approved change
checks: The alert pages on-call and opens an incident
The deployment waits for change approval
objectives: Run incidents in Jira Service Management

days.topic: Integrations and APIs: REST API, Webhooks and Forge Apps
subtopics: Authentication with API tokens and OAuth
days.lab_task: Create and update work items through the REST API, send a webhook to a test endpoint on transition and build a small Forge app panel.
days.deliverable: API scripts, webhook and Forge app
checks: API calls create and update work items
The Forge panel shows on work items

days.topic: Atlassian Guard and Security: SSO, SCIM and Data Security Policies
days.lab_task: Connect SAML single sign-on and SCIM from an identity provider, apply an authentication policy, block exports with a data security policy and audit the setup.
checks: Users sign in through the identity provider
Exports are blocked where the policy applies

days.topic: Data Residency, Backups and Sandboxes
days.lab_task: Pin data to a residency location, create a sandbox, copy a space into it, test a workflow change there and run a backup and restore test.
checks: The workflow change is tested in the sandbox

days.topic: Moving from Jira Data Center to Cloud with the Jira Cloud Migration Assistant
subtopics: Why Data Center customers are moving
days.lab_task: Assess a seeded Data Center instance, plan apps and users, run a test migration of two spaces with the migration assistant and complete post-migration checks.
days.deliverable: Migration assessment and test migration report
checks: Two spaces migrate with data intact

days.topic: Atlassian Analytics and the Data Lake
subtopics: Charts and dashboards from Jira data
days.lab_task: Build an Atlassian Analytics dashboard of cycle time and throughput across spaces, join it with service data and connect an external BI tool.
checks: Cycle time and throughput show by team
The BI tool reads the data lake

days.topic: Marketplace Apps: Evaluation, Security and Governance
subtopics: Security and data handling of apps
days.lab_task: Evaluate two apps for a reporting need against security and cost criteria, set an app access rule and build the app request process.
checks: Both apps are scored on security and cost
The access rule limits app data access
App requests follow the approval process

days.topic: Rovo Agents and AI Automation in Jira
subtopics: Building custom agents with Rovo Studio
days.lab_task: Build a Rovo agent that drafts acceptance criteria from a story, call it from an automation rule and review ten outputs for quality.
days.deliverable: Agent with automation and a quality review
checks: The rule calls the agent on new stories
At least eight of ten outputs are usable

days.topic: Jira Site Governance: Naming, Templates and Space Sprawl
subtopics: Naming standards for spaces and fields
days.lab_task: Write governance standards for the site, build a space request process with templates, archive five inactive spaces and run a health check.
days.deliverable: Governance standards and a cleaner site
checks: Naming and template standards are published
New spaces come through the request process

days.topic: ACP-120 Jira Administration for Cloud Exam Preparation
subtopics: Checking the current status of related exams
days.lab_task: Take a timed ACP-120 practice set, map every miss to a course day and practise the weakest tasks on the practice site.
checks: A timed practice set is completed
Each miss is mapped to a course day
The weakest tasks are practised on the site

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Administered Jira Site for Five Teams
days.lab_task: Deliver a Jira site for five teams with group access, shared schemes, complex workflows, automation, a service space with Assets, SSO and governance standards, and present it to the IT lead persona.
checks: Teams work in spaces with the shared configuration
The service space meets its SLAs
SSO, SCIM and app controls work

advanced.summary: For Jira platform owners, enterprise administrators and Atlassian architects. Covers enterprise architecture with several sites and organisations, configuration strategy, performance at scale, enterprise service management, Assets and CMDB design, portfolio management with Jira Align and Plans, delivery metrics, Forge development, data and integration architecture, security and compliance, large migrations from Data Center, instance consolidation, AI at scale with Rovo, the Atlassian platform, adoption programmes, the admin operating model, licensing and cost, advanced troubleshooting and regulated teams.
prerequisites: Administers Jira for a large organisation
Holds ACP-120 or has equivalent experience
Responsible for platform design, migration or governance
outcomes: Design Jira architectures, configuration strategies and service management for large organisations
Run migrations, consolidations and integrations at scale
Govern security, compliance, AI and cost
Lead adoption and the admin operating model

days.topic: Enterprise Jira Architecture: Multiple Sites, Organisations and Federation
days.lab_task: Design the Jira architecture for a company with three business units and two regulated regions, decide sites and organisations and defend it in a review.
checks: Sites, organisations and identity are defined
The review records decisions and risks

days.topic: Configuration Strategy: Shared Schemes, Standard Workflows and Change Control
days.lab_task: Design three standard configurations for software, service and business teams, move ten spaces onto them and run a change through change control.
checks: The change passes review and sandbox test

days.topic: Performance at Scale: Large Sites, JQL Load and Automation Limits
subtopics: Large numbers of work items, fields and schemes
Expensive JQL in filters and boards
Working with Atlassian Support on performance
days.lab_task: Find the slowest boards, filters and rules on a large seeded site, fix the top five and measure the improvement.
checks: Load times and rule usage improve

days.topic: Enterprise Service Management with Jira Service Management
subtopics: HR, facilities and legal service spaces
days.lab_task: Launch HR and facilities service spaces beside IT with a shared help centre, route requests across departments and report service levels for all three.
checks: HR and facilities spaces take requests
Cross-department requests reach the right team
Service levels are reported for all teams

days.topic: Assets and CMDB Design in Jira Service Management
subtopics: Importing assets from discovery and files
days.lab_task: Design a CMDB schema for services, servers and applications, import data from two sources, use it for impact analysis on an incident and set data owners.
days.deliverable: CMDB schema with imports and governance
checks: The schema links services to servers and applications
Incident impact is found through references

days.topic: Portfolio Management with Jira Align and Jira Plans
days.lab_task: Build a portfolio from strategy themes to epics with capacity and OKRs, run a quarterly portfolio review and recommend tooling.
checks: Strategy themes link to delivery work
The quarterly review makes funding decisions

days.topic: Delivery Metrics Programmes: Flow Metrics, DORA and OKRs
subtopics: Flow metrics: velocity, time, load and efficiency
DORA metrics from Jira and CI/CD data
days.lab_task: Define flow and DORA metrics for five teams from Jira and pipeline data, build a leadership dashboard and run one improvement cycle.
days.deliverable: Metrics programme with an improvement cycle
checks: The improvement cycle changes one metric

days.topic: Forge App Development for Enterprise Needs
days.lab_task: Build a Forge app that adds a risk panel to work items, stores scores, runs a scheduled check and deploys from development to production.
checks: The risk panel shows on work items
The app runs in production with minimal scopes

days.topic: Data and Integration Architecture: Jira as a Source for BI and ITSM
subtopics: Integration with ServiceNow and other ITSM tools
Integration with CRM and support tools
days.lab_task: Design the integration architecture for Jira with BI, an ITSM tool and a CRM, build one event-driven flow and set up monitoring.
days.deliverable: Integration architecture with one live flow
checks: Each integration has a pattern and owner

days.topic: Security, Compliance and Audit: Audit Logs, Data Retention and eDiscovery
subtopics: Compliance certifications of the cloud platform
days.lab_task: Review access for a regulated space, set retention rules, export audit logs for an audit request and find sensitive data in work items.
days.deliverable: Access review, retention rules and audit evidence
checks: The audit request is answered with evidence

days.topic: Large-Scale Migration Programmes: Data Center to Cloud
days.lab_task: Plan a three-wave migration for a large Data Center instance with app paths, identity, clean-up, communication and rollback, and run a rehearsal of wave one.
days.deliverable: Migration programme plan and rehearsal report
checks: Waves, apps and identity are planned
Data Center shutdown has dates and owners

days.topic: Consolidating Multiple Jira Instances
subtopics: Conflict resolution for fields and workflows
days.lab_task: Compare two seeded Jira sites, resolve field and workflow conflicts, merge a pilot space and confirm links and history are kept.
checks: The pilot space moves with history
Links still work after the move

days.topic: AI at Scale: Rovo Agents, Teamwork Graph and Guardrails
subtopics: Training people to use AI well
days.lab_task: Roll out Rovo agents to two departments with permissions and review steps, measure time saved over a seeded month and write the AI use policy.
days.deliverable: AI rollout with value and policy
checks: Agents work for both departments with correct access

days.topic: The Atlassian Platform: Jira, Confluence, Loom and Compass Together
days.lab_task: Design how the course company uses Jira, Confluence, Loom and Compass together, set up a goal tracked across apps and register services in Compass.
days.deliverable: Platform usage design with a working example
checks: Each app has a clear purpose
The goal shows progress from linked work
Services appear in Compass with owners

days.topic: Adoption and Change Programmes for Jira
days.lab_task: Plan the adoption of Jira for three new departments with training paths, champions and templates, and set adoption measures.
checks: Each role has a training path
Champions are named for each department

days.topic: Jira Administration Operating Model: Admin Teams, Requests and Service Levels
days.lab_task: Design the admin operating model with roles, a request service space with service levels and a delegation model, and report a seeded month of admin metrics.
days.deliverable: Admin operating model and metrics report
objectives: Run Jira administration as a service

days.topic: Licensing, Cost and Vendor Management for Atlassian Cloud
days.lab_task: Build a cost model for Jira and apps, find savings from inactive users and duplicate apps and prepare a renewal pack.

days.topic: Advanced Troubleshooting: Support Tools, Logs and Atlassian Support
days.lab_task: Diagnose four seeded enterprise problems, an app failure, a visibility puzzle, an automation loop and a data inconsistency, raise one support request and write a review.
checks: Each problem's cause is shown with evidence
The support request has all needed details

days.topic: Jira for Regulated Teams: Validation, Traceability and Audit Trails
days.lab_task: Set up a validated space with requirements traceability, approvals, test links and change control, and walk an auditor through the evidence.
checks: Requirements trace to tests and releases
Approvals are recorded with who and when
The auditor walkthrough has no open findings

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise Jira Platform Design
days.lab_task: Present the enterprise Jira platform design to a steering committee with the architecture, configuration strategy, service management and CMDB, migration and integration plans, security, AI governance, cost model and admin operating model.
days.deliverable: Platform design with evidence and a steering decision
checks: Architecture and configuration strategy pass review
Migration and integration plans are realistic
Security, AI and cost governance have owners
